newsitem.title: FRANCE: Diggers find Roman relics in Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Diggers find Roman relics in Algeria.

text.p: Algerians working on a water project have found more burial grounds and terracotta pottery from the Roman era in northern Algeria, the official news agency APS said on Monday.

It said the area of Oum el-Bouaghi, some 400 km (250 miles) southeast of Algiers, already has several archaelogical sites and local officials have called in specialists from the Archaeological Research Institute to study the latest finds.
